title: Jamie Dimon says JPMorgan is considering prediction market services
summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon reveals to "CBS Evening News" anchor Tony Dokoupil that his bank is considering offering prediction market services. "It's possible one day we'll do something like that," Dimon says. "We're not gonna be in sports. We're not gonna be in politics. There's a bunch of stuff we won't do.
